title: ACL Reconstruction Rehabilitation
case: Presentation (from the chapter): Goals before surgery: no swelling, full extension, good quadriceps activation, normal gait. Patients who enter surgery with good range and strength tend to recover better [Ref – to verify].
qa: Why is full extension a priority in week 1? Loss of extension causes abnormal gait and long-term problems.
What is LSI? Limb symmetry index: involved limb as a percentage of the uninvolved limb.
Why use criteria and not time alone? Patients progress at different rates; criteria reduce reinjury risk.
How does a meniscal repair change the protocol? Often restricted weight-bearing and deep flexion for weeks.
Why measure psychological readiness? Fear and low confidence affect return to sport and reinjury risk.

redFlags.Finding: Fever, red hot wound, increasing swelling
Loss of extension that does not improve (block)
New giving way, large effusion after a pivot

exercise.Exercise: Quadriceps sets, SLR, heel props for extension
Leg press, squats, step-ups, split squats
exercise.Dose example: 3 to 4 sets of 6 to 12, progress load

exercise.Exercise: Hamstring curls (delay or adapt with hamstring graft)

modalityNotes: Neuromuscular electrical stimulation for quadriceps activation early [Ref – to verify]; cryotherapy and compression for swelling.
pathway: Open chain knee extension can begin early within a limited range (often 90 to 45 degrees), progressing range over time, as per protocol [Ref – to verify].
